summary: Closer is the second studio album by vocalist Josh Groban, released in November 2003. Like his debut, about half of its songs are sung in English, with the rest in Italian, Spanish and French. The note also states that Closer was the top selling classical album of the 2000s in the US according to Nielsen SoundScan.
one_line: Josh Groban's 2003 second studio album, half English and half Italian, Spanish and French, and the top-selling US classical album of the 2000s.
key_facts: Closer is the second studio album by vocalist Josh Groban.
Like Groban's first studio album, half of Closer's songs are sung in English.
The remainder of Closer's songs are sung in various other languages.
Closer's non-English songs are sung in Italian, Spanish and French.
Closer was the top selling classical album of the 2000s in the US, according to Nielsen SoundScan.
